name: Valorous Brigade
body:
School enchantment; Level cleric/oracle 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a war banner)

EFFECT

Range long (400 feet + 40 feet per level)
Target one creature per caster level
Duration 1 round/level
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You wave the banner high and shout words of victory as you embolden your allies towards certain victory. When you cast this spell each of the targets gains the challenge ability of a cavalier of your caster level, though with no additional bonus from an order. In addition each target gains the aura of courage ability as the paladin ability of the same name. If any of the targets is currently suffering from a fear effect it ends, if suffering from a compulsion effect, those effects immediately end unless the source has more hit dice than you. If you are slain or knocked unconscious, this spell immediately ends.
